# Lab 2.4: Explore Metadata with INFORMATION_SCHEMA

## What We Are Going to Do
Query INFORMATION_SCHEMA views to list tables, columns, nested field paths, table options and partitions.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] List the tables in a dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, table_type, creation_time
FROM lab02.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
ORDER BY creation_time;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] List columns and nested paths.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
FROM lab02.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE table_name = 'type_demo';

SELECT field_path, data_type
FROM lab02.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS
WHERE table_name = 'orders_nested';</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Read table options.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, option_name, option_value
FROM lab02.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Query the whole region.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_schema, COUNT(*) AS tables
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
GROUP BY table_schema;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A **dataset qualifier** (`lab02.`) shows one dataset. A **region qualifier** (`region-us`) shows every dataset in that region.

5. **[CLI] Run a metadata query from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT table_name, partition_id, total_rows
 FROM lab02.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS LIMIT 10'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| TABLES | Every table and view in `lab02` |
| COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS | Paths such as `items.sale_price` |
| TABLE_OPTIONS | Descriptions, expirations, labels |
| Region qualifier | Metadata across all datasets in `US` |
